title: LVR Blocklist Configuration
description: Schema for LinuxVR (lvr) blocklist sources defining domain categories for selective blocking.

urlList.description: Video player host domains and URL patterns (mapped to Videos category)

imageHostUrlList.description: Image host domains and URL patterns (mapped to Images category)

stringHostUrlList.description: String/text download host domains and URL patterns (mapped to Strings category)

whiteListedAssetUrls.description: Whitelisted asset host domains that must never be blocked

additionalProperties.description: Custom domain category list (e.g. Analytics, Telemetry, Ads)
